title: PermissionInfo expands a Permission to include any groups that may have the specified Permission.

entitlement.description: Entitlement is the entitlement define for the entity type.

entity_type.description: EntityType is the string representation of the entity type.

groups.description: Groups is a list of groups that have the Entitlement on the Entity.

url.description: EntityReference is the URL of the entity that the permission applies to.
